title: दूसरी राय
caption: दिवाली से पहले राहुल अपने ही आँकड़ों पर आधारित दूसरी राय चाहता है। लूमी उसकी कहानी सुनाती है।
linkedin_text: In the free month or on a paid plan, the ScoreMyBiz Advisor takes a business question typed in the owner's own language and answers using his own numbers, with a few questions a day. It is not financial, legal or tax advice and can make mistakes.
